title: tools/check_static.py: add option to say which Windows build

notes.body: @rtommy - shocking how slow this runs, but if you are doing Release builds, you would need to call with --windows-build-type Release to find the object files.

fantastic! Well done!

Yes, it works for me too now, it showed me issues they way it should be :)
